title: Разработка программного обеспечения для системы электронных государственных закупок — ADB Проект 55109-001 Фаза 1
title_en: e-Procurement System Software Development — ADB Project 55109-001 Phase 1
ai_digital_scope: Software development firm engagement for e-procurement system digitalization under ADB TA grant. Scope: replace paper-based operations with electronic platform, modernize existing procurement software, blockchain-based bid/performance securities, API integration with state treasury. QCBS 90:10 quality-cost ratio. 42-month contract.
win_probability_rationale: ADB donor rules procurement = most transparent modality. New system (no incumbent). 90:10 quality-cost ratio strongly favors technical capability over price. Foreign firms with e-procurement implementation experience (Eastern Europe, Baltic states, CIS) are well-positioned. Blockchain bid securities is a differentiator.

title: Закупка суперкомпьютеров / GPU-кластера для Министерства цифрового развития / УДП КР
title_en: Procurement of Supercomputers / GPU Cluster for Ministry of Digital Development / Presidential Administration UDP
ai_digital_scope: 4 supercomputer systems with GPU accelerators. Previous tender failed due to export control issues with Nvidia (H100 chips on ECCN). Budget: 220 million KGS (~$2.5M). New tender re-launched with US Embassy engagement. Systems to support national AI strategy, government AI workloads, Digital Som infrastructure. Potential Chinese GPU alternative (Huawei Ascend) being evaluated.
win_probability_rationale: Previous tender failed — creates opportunity for new bidder. US export control on Nvidia H100 chips creates genuine uncertainty. Chinese GPU vendors (Huawei Ascend 910B) are viable alternative and not subject to US export rules. European and Russian alternatives also under evaluation. ICB format with foreign eligibility.

title: Разработка программного обеспечения для инфраструктуры цифрового сома (ЦБДК) — кошельки и AML
title_en: Digital Som CBDC Infrastructure Software Development — Wallets, AML/KYC Platform
ai_digital_scope: Digital Som CBDC technical infrastructure under Law №74 (April 2025). Full implementation by January 2027. Phase: consumer wallet apps (iOS/Android), bank integration APIs, Central Treasury connection, offline transaction capability, AML/KYC AI monitoring, integration with Tunduk identity layer. National Bank authority over issuance and regulatory framework.
win_probability_rationale: Brand new system — no incumbent. National Bank procurement is more transparent than line ministry procurement. CBDC is technically sophisticated requiring specialized international expertise. SWIFT, BIS Innovation Hub, and specialized fintech firms (R3, Hyperledger ecosystem) are natural candidates. Russian fintech firms (ЦБ РФ CBDC experience) are competitive.

ai_digital_scope: Post-April 2026 reorganization — Tunduk transferred from former Mintsifry to GP Infocom under Presidential Administration. New UDP leadership issuing TORs. Modernization: REST API gateway upgrade, data analytics dashboard for government data flows, FHIR health data integration, 30% more digital services target (EU-set KPI), new Tunduk mobile app integration.

EGA/Cybernetica (UXP) are natural incumbents for core upgrade. Window exists for analytics layer, health data integration, and mobile app components as separate sub-contracts.

ai_digital_scope: UN Joint Programme (WHO+UNDP+UNFPA+UNICEF) funded by EU SDG Fund, Spain, Sweden. $4.03M total, 2024-2027. Scope: 60 health facilities EHR integration, 3M vaccination records, disability certificates system (120K users), sick leave digitization (280K workers), telemedicine expansion to rural/mountain areas serving 700K children. FHIR/HL7 standards required.
win_probability_rationale: UN procurement rules (CQS) are transparent. EU-funded mandate favors EU-standard technical approach (FHIR/HL7). Some subcomponents already underway (mid-implementation). Best opportunity is sub-contract for telemedicine platform, AI clinical decision support, or mobile health app. WHO/UNDP national office relationships are key.
